events.title: Launching the Touching Grass Simulator demo!
events.summary: Today, the world can finally stay indoors, and touch some grass! Now what is next? Here's the plans for everything that will be happening until the steam next fest! Flowers There's different kinds of flowers with different effects! Yield type flowers These are flowers that give you better chances of increasing the yield. events.title: Water barrel & flower changes
events.summary: Added Flowers now by default reduce growth speed. This depends on the flower. 0.9x for daisies. This is only additive for now. (Formula: 1/SUM(1/0.9)) A positive value simply adds. e.g. 1.25 multiplier on 2 plants = 1.5x multiplier. Added a rain barrel that gets filled up by rain. You can refill your watering can at the rain barrel. Changes Consecutive bonus chance now decreases by 5x (10x before). e.g.: before: chance = 100% - 2nd chance = 10% - 3rd chance = 1% now: chance = 100% - 2nd chance =

events.title: Internal shop improvements & placeable flowers
events.summary: New Flowers that affect grass now glow green when planting the grass. Added daisy seeds to the shop. The store is now "smart". That means it keeps track of what you selected so far and doesn't select you any more items if your available money isn't high enough. Changes Fixed multiple issues with the new preview system. Fixed flickering of Marijuhana preview. Removed ability to pick up grass when holding seeds/the watering can. A grass blade is only sold for 1.15$. A flower now only buffs for 2%.

events.title: Minor Fixes
events.summary: Fixed an issue where saved sound settings wouldnt apply on load. Fixed an issue where the inventory bar would appear as if it selected an item but didnt actually select any on load. Hopefully Improved performance a little when grass is growing. (Should be multithreaded now)

events.title: Steam store page now live!
events.summary: Today, Steam finally approved my request to publish the store page! Let's take this opportunity to review the current state of development. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! What is the current state of the game? The game is fully playable. It's short, but the core gameplay loop is functional.
